Gets all configured Id P details for the specified customer.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v2/admin/customers/:customerId/idp

Gets all configured Id P details for the specified customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

QUERY PARAMETERS
scimEnabled
boolean

Returns all SCIM IdPs if set to true. Returns all non SCIM IdPs if set to false.

userAttributes
boolean
search
string

The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

page
int32

Specifies the page number.

Example: 1
pagesize
int32

Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.

Example: 20
